text:
zoe: Pushed a small PR to reconcile pricing, quotas, and usage examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7282
zoe: Main asks: (1) rename 'pro' -> 'scale' in the pricing table with a legacy mapping, (2) add a downloadable CSV + Google Sheets formula showing per-minute rollup -> 30d invoice calc, (3) clarify burst-credit application order and fallback behavior, (4) fix dashboard links and inline SVG rendering on preview.
liam: I'll own the CSV and the sheet. Added a sample invoice formula to the PR notes: `=SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(C2:C="generation",D2:D*E2:E, D2:D*E2:E*0.75)))` which demonstrates per-token vs per-request adjustments. Also included a ready-to-download /examples/billing-preview-7282.csv.
emily: Editorial: change wording from "requests are blocked" to "requests may be throttled or routed to a fallback model depending on routing policy" and add a one-line note about the 30s graceful downgrade window.
zoe: Good call. I also added a short FAQ entry: "How are burst credits applied?" Answer: minute buckets are consumed first, burst credits apply within the minute window, then remaining usage rolls into the 30d invoice window.
sam: Ops note: inline SVG timeline is being blocked by CSP on the preview site. OPS-1987 opened to allow docs-static.s3.redwood.ai as an allowed source for docs.
ops-bot: OPS-1987 created. Ops recommendation: link to dashboard slug (`/d/usage/pricing-overview`) rather than panel anchors for durable links; if a panel anchor is required we can add a redirect in OPS-1990.
liam: Added PromQL examples in the PR for copy-paste: minute view: `sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[1m])) by (account)` and invoice window: `sum(increase(redwood_usage_tokens_total[30d])) by (account)`. Also included a Grafana query param example: `?var-account=acct_77`.
emily: Quick math check: one row in the pricing table still uses tokens instead of kilotokens which makes the sample invoice look off by 1000x. Zoe can you confirm the spreadsheet uses the tokens/1000 conversion?
zoe: Fixed the spreadsheet to convert tokens -> kTokens where the price is per-kToken, updated CSV and PR description. Also swapped the SDK header snippet to the JSON header form (redacted): `X-Redwood-Usage: {"account":"acct_77","units":120,"unit_type":"tokens"}` and added a curl example with `<REDACTED>` key.
sam: Thanks. One more editorial nit: include a short line clarifying cache behavior: cache hits do not incur forward-pass token billing; only cache misses and finalization frames increment token counters. Great for support to point to.
docs-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-7282--docs.redwood.ai — please verify CSV download, sheet formula rendering, and that the timeline SVG either renders or falls back to the hosted image link. Staging note: panel ids may differ from prod.
zoe: I'll merge after @emily gives final thumbs and OPS confirms the CSP tweak. Targeting EOD to sync with the billing preview release. :rocket:
